title: Canonical work-evidence record
description: The L1 artefact every class adapter must emit (§8). CREST absorbs heterogeneity; source systems change nothing. A record providing only the mandatory core is valid Tier-1-capable evidence.

activity.description: Matched against a Definition's activity code by the evidence pipeline.

workerJoiningIdentifier.description: Whatever joining identifier the source has. Resolved to a Party by the matching rules (§4.1); no match means the unclear queue, never a silent guess.

value.description: For kind=national-id this is the raw number in transit only. It is resolved at ingestion and discarded — never persisted, not even in fixtures (W9).

geography.description: Coarse only. A raw GPS fix is a rejection, not a truncation.

enrichment.description: Beneficiary counts, session metadata, supervisor identity, device attestation. Optional, kept verbatim, read only by a definition's tier map.
